description: An expander for Pick6 that goes immediately to its right, giving the two custom patterns at the end of Pick6's pattern list a knob per step.

params.text: Sets which string that step of the first custom pattern picks, 1 to 6, or 0 for a step that picks nothing.
Sets which string that step of the second custom pattern picks, 1 to 6, or 0 for a step that picks nothing.

notes: A lamp in the name of each module lights when this is attached to a Pick6. With no Pick6 on its left, the knobs change nothing.
The two custom patterns are the last two entries on Pick6's pattern knob; a pick indicator above each column lights while Pick6 is playing that one.
menu: Copy...: Left to Right, Right to Left, From Pick6 to Left, From Pick6 to Right — copies one column into the other, or the pattern Pick6 is playing into a column.
Clear...: Left Pattern, Right Pattern, Both Pattern — sets every step of that column to 0, which picks nothing.
